BLS OEWS · May 2025

Austin, Chicago, and Seattle occupational wages.

WageGrid publishes official Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics for 25 occupations in three metros. No invented wages. Suppressed BLS cells stay blank. OEWS covers wage-and-salary workers and excludes the self-employed.

How to read a page

Each metro × occupation page shows employment, mean and median wages, and the location quotient from OEWS May 2025. Hourly figures are omitted when BLS publishes the occupation annual-only (common for teachers). Compare the same job across the three metros, or switch occupations inside one metro.
